packageRules.description: Majors too: a runner image ships nothing to Hackage consumers. Safe only while every job on a versioned runner is a required check, which holds a broken image's merge.
Renovate never changes a compatibility group, so each GHC pin moves only within its series. The weekly drift check flags series changes.
Default versioning hides four-component PVP versions. hlint's tags carry a v prefix that mise.toml omits.
Some ghcup-hs tags, such as v0.21, have no release download.
tasty-quickcheck bounds both tasty and QuickCheck, so bumping one alone can open a PR that fails to resolve.
